item.title: Naitomi~chu! -Obake no Mare to Iyashi no Hitoiki-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: CyberStep, Inc.
  • 発売日: 2024-12-11
  • スコア: 5.79/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: なぃとみ～ちゅ！ -おばけのめあと癒しのヒトイキ-
  • 英語名: Naitomi~chu! -Obake no Mare to Iyashi no Hitoiki-

别名

  • Naitomi~chu! -Obake no Mare to Iyashi no Hitoiki-

あらすじ

A peculiar daily life begins with a pure-hearted ghost girl…

[Mare], a sweet and gentle ghost girl has suddenly appeared in front of the exhausted protagonist.

Although she’s a ghost, she goes out of her way to bring comfort and ease to the protagonist.
